jaFieldProjection.titleJa: カキの色と丸みのある輪郭
jaFieldProjection.altJa: 淡い背景に、やや平たい丸みのある橙色のカキを一個描いています。上部には緑がかった広いへたと短い柄があり、果実全体が見えます。
jaFieldProjection.observationJa: 橙色の果実の輪郭と、上部に付く広いへたの位置を見ます。色だけでなく、全体の形やへたの付く部分も観察します。
jaFieldProjection.limitJa: 一般的な外観を描いた一例です。全てのカキが同じ形や色とは限りません。この図だけで品種や甘渋、熟度、品質、食べられるかどうかは判定しません。

findings.reason: At full1024 and330px, one whole orange gently flattened-round fruit, broad four-lobed calyx and short central stalk remain clearly readable. No chopped fruit, exposed flesh, seeds, text, diagnostic badges or extraneous props.

All4Japanese fields match the generated pixels. Alt describes the orange whole form and greenish broad calyx; observation combines contour with attachment position; limit explicitly rejects universal color/shape, cultivar, astringency, ripeness, quality and edibility inference.

Original S1PDF104/printed98 supports the named orange rounded fruit example. Its photograph does not clearly reveal the calyx shape from that angle. Author explicitly records the generated broad calyx as a generic illustration detail, not direct source-photograph evidence; metadata describes the illustration without falsely saying the source proves this feature.
